title: Brand Color Input
description: Stops near-miss brand colours from shipping by naming the closest palette token with a perceptual (OKLab) distance and offering a one-tap snap when a value is a hair off (#1e40ae vs #1e40af), and by catching pasted junk, the letter O for zero, a digit too many or few, alpha hidden in 4- and 8-digit hex, and Android #AARRGGBB order that CSS renders as a different colour.
stops: Brand colour off by a hex digit
